authors: S.S. Aleshin, A.L. Kataev, K.V. Stepanyantz
title: Structure of three-loop contributions to the beta-function of N=1 SQED with N_f flavors, regularized by the dimensional reduction
claim: In N=1 SQED with N_f flavours regularized by DRED (DR-bar), the scheme-dependent three-loop (N_f)^2 contribution to the beta-function contains structures analogous to integrals of delta-singularities (the mechanism that yields NSVZ with higher-derivative regularization); adding the scheme-independent N_f terms reproduces the known three-loop beta.
symmetry_argument: Comparison of the DRED loop-integral structure with the double-total-derivative structure that underlies NSVZ in higher-derivative regularization.

proved: Three-loop (N_f)^2 DR-bar contribution computed and structurally analyzed (abstract).
checked_partially: NSVZ status in DR-bar not stated in the abstract (see S1e.10_AGKS2016).

cross_checks: Reproduces known three-loop SQED beta (Jack-Jones-North line, S1e.02_JJN1996b).
